content.value_statement: Influencer campaigns often have scattered spend, revenue, and attribution data. This skill turns those inputs into ROI, ROAS, EMV, LTV, and executive-ready return summaries.
actual_capabilities: Computes direct ROI, profit, and ROAS from investment and revenue inputs.
Estimates earned media value from impressions, engagements, CPM, and CPE assumptions.
Calculates CPM, CPR, CPE, CPV, CPC, CPA, and CAC against benchmarks.
Compares first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution.
Projects LTV-based ROI from new customers, average LTV, and investment data.
Ranks creators by ROI and prepares CVI-ready ROI scope scores.
limitations: Results depend on accurate spend, revenue, conversion, and customer value inputs.
EMV and attribution outputs are directional estimates, not audited financial proof.
Live platform data requires compatible host connectors or manual data entry.
It does not create the final slide report; use report-generator for that step.

use_cases.title: Report campaign profitability
use_cases.description: Calculate ROI, ROAS, profit, and efficiency metrics after an influencer campaign closes.

use_cases.title: Defend marketing budget
use_cases.description: Convert spend and return data into clear numbers for finance and leadership review.

use_cases.title: Compare creators and tiers
use_cases.description: Rank creators by revenue, ROI, ROAS, and budget efficiency before reallocating spend.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate basic campaign ROI
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner ROI request with spend and revenue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate influencer ROI for a campaign with $25,000 spend, $72,000 revenue, and 2.1 million reach.

prompt_templates.title: Compare ROI methods
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using direct return, EMV, and cost metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this campaign using direct ROI, ROAS, EMV, CPM, CPC, CPA, and CAC. I will provide the input table.

prompt_templates.title: Model attribution impact
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with multi-touch customer journeys.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution for this influencer campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Build an executive ROI readout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request combining ROI, LTV, creator rankings, and CVI inputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive ROI summary with direct ROI, LTV-based ROI, by-creator ROI, benchmarks, and CVI-ready ROI scoring.

output_examples.input: Campaign spend is $25,000. Direct revenue is $72,000. Reach is 2.1 million.
output_examples.output: The campaign generated $47,000 profit, 188% ROI, and 2.88:1 ROAS. CPM is $11.90 using the reach input.

output_examples.input: Five creators have different fees, revenue, clicks, and conversions.
output_examples.output: The output ranks each creator by ROI and ROAS, then flags which tier should receive more budget.

output_examples.input: New customers, AOV, repeat rate, and average LTV are available.
output_examples.output: The output compares immediate revenue ROI with projected LTV ROI and explains which number is suitable for leadership.

best_practices: Separate hard revenue, EMV, and LTV projections so stakeholders can see each assumption.
Show formulas and source inputs for every headline ROI number.
Compare CPA, CAC, and ROAS against the right channel and industry benchmarks.
anti_patterns: Do not mix EMV with direct revenue as if both are cash returns.
Do not hide attribution assumptions when multiple creators influenced the same sale.
Do not rank creators only by revenue without considering fee, margin, and customer quality.

faq.question: What data do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Provide campaign spend, revenue, reach, impressions, engagements, clicks, conversions, and customer data when available.

faq.question: Can it work without live analytics integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can calculate results from manually supplied tables and campaign exports.

faq.question: Does it calculate earned media value?
faq.answer: Yes. It estimates EMV from impression and engagement methods, then labels the result as directional.

faq.question: Can it compare attribution models?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution views.

faq.question: Does it replace a finance audit?
faq.answer: No. It supports marketing analysis and planning, but finance teams should verify final accounting claims.

faq.question: How does this help Claude, Codex, or Claude Code users?
faq.answer: It gives those agents a structured workflow for influencer ROI math, assumptions, and stakeholder summaries.
